I have implemented the flight controller in `controller.js` following the recipe:

- **Velocity Filtering**: Low-pass filters noisy velocity observations (`vf`) to suppress differentiation noise and provide clean damping and acceleration estimates.
- **Delay-Matched Fast/Slow Acceleration Disturbance Observer**: Tracks lagged specific thrust and compares measured acceleration against the delay-matched model acceleration (accounting for tilt and linear drag) with both a slow filter (`dSlow`, capturing payload mass offset and steady wind) and a fast filter (`dFast`, capturing transient gusts).
- **Yaw & Local Position Integrals**: Applies a bounded yaw integral to cancel weak-motor yaw torque without saturating diagonal motors, and integrates position error locally near alignment and landing targets.
- **Smooth Reference Filter**: Uses a deceleration-profiled, lead-bounded reference trajectory (`ref`, `refVel`) to prevent slingshot overshoot and motor saturation.
- **Gate Exit Lock & Predictive Cross Abort**: Predicts gate-plane intercept `(y, z)` under active gusts and aborts back to alignment if clearance margins are threatened before the braking point of no return, then locks `(y, z)` to the gate centre after crossing until the drone body has exited `+0.22 m` past the gate plane.
- **Ramp Pad Descent**: Smoothly ramps the landing target altitude down when centered over the pad, pausing if a gust perturbs horizontal error and reducing tilt/thrust upon touchdown.

SMOKE=4/4

I have implemented the flight controller in `controller.js` following the recipe:

- **Velocity Filtering**: Low-pass filters noisy velocity observations (`vf`) to suppress differentiation noise and provide clean damping and acceleration estimates.
- **Delay-Matched Fast/Slow Acceleration Disturbance Observer**: Tracks lagged specific thrust and compares measured acceleration against the delay-matched model acceleration (accounting for tilt and linear drag) with both a slow filter (`dSlow`, capturing payload mass offset and steady wind) and a fast filter (`dFast`, capturing transient gusts).
- **Yaw & Local Position Integrals**: Applies a bounded yaw integral to cancel weak-motor yaw torque without saturating diagonal motors, and integrates position error locally near alignment and landing targets.
- **Smooth Reference Filter**: Uses a deceleration-profiled, lead-bounded reference trajectory (`ref`, `refVel`) to prevent slingshot overshoot and motor saturation.
- **Gate Exit Lock & Predictive Cross Abort**: Predicts gate-plane intercept `(y, z)` under active gusts and aborts back to alignment if clearance margins are threatened before the braking point of no return, then locks `(y, z)` to the gate centre after crossing until the drone body has exited `+0.22 m` past the gate plane.
- **Ramp Pad Descent**: Smoothly ramps the landing target altitude down when centered over the pad, pausing if a gust perturbs horizontal error and reducing tilt/thrust upon touchdown.
